Variante pronta: nel CSS di {0} ridefini: Variant ready: in the CSS of {0} redefine the variables that change. The client turns it on with the “{1}” switch.
Una variante è un interruttore per chi u: A variant is a switch for whoever uses the component: it adds to the first element a class such as card--dark, which changes only a few variables.
Dai alla variante un nome fatto di parol: Give the variant a name made of words, for example “Dark”.
The component already has a prop “{0}”.
Il primo elemento del componente non ha: The component's first element has no class: give it one (for example “card”) and try again.
